categories.main_business_segments: Jinlihua Electric Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two segments: the manufacturing and sales of glass insulators for high-voltage, ultra-high-voltage, and extra-high-voltage power transmission lines, and the cultural media segment focused on theatrical production and performance. The insulator business dominates revenue, accounting for over 86% of total sales in 2024, while the cultural segment involves drama production, investment, and related cultural services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced glass insulator manufacturing technologies, including patented designs and automated production lines with German-imported forming equipment. It has developed mature AC/DC ultra-high-voltage glass insulator production capabilities and is upgrading to a fully automated digital smart factory with 24-hour unmanned operation. In the cultural segment, it employs professional theatrical production teams and international collaboration for high-quality drama creation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers for the insulator business are major Chinese power grid companies, including State Grid Corporation and China Southern Power Grid, as well as overseas emerging market power enterprises. The cultural segment serves theater audiences primarily in major Chinese cities and international markets through performances and collaborations with renowned artists and theaters.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Shanxi and Zhejiang provinces. It also has expanding overseas markets in Asia, Africa, and Europe. The cultural business is centered in Beijing and other major Chinese cities, with international performances in France and collaborations with European theaters.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jinlihua Electric is positioned midstream in the power transmission supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of critical glass insulator components used in transmission lines. It procures raw materials from qualified suppliers and produces semi-finished glass parts internally. The cultural segment operates downstream, producing and presenting theatrical performances directly to consumers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in high-voltage glass insulator technology, focusing on product reliability, lightweight and energy-saving designs, and manufacturing automation. It invests in digitalization and smart factory upgrades to improve efficiency and quality. The cultural segment emphasizes original high-quality drama production and international collaboration to enhance artistic influence and market reach.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of glass insulator products to power grid companies via bidding and contracts. The cultural segment earns revenue from ticket sales, performance fees, and cultural product sales through self-operated, cooperative, and commercial performance models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the glass insulator market, Jinlihua is among a few domestic leaders with mature ultra-high-voltage product capabilities and participates in major national grid tenders. Competitors include companies like Nanjing Electric and Sichuan Global. In the cultural sector, its subsidiary Central China Times is a leading private drama production company with strong brand recognition and market presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Jinlihua achieved revenue of approximately RMB 272.78 million, a 48.89% increase year-over-year, driven mainly by a 92.5% growth in the insulator segment. Net profit attributable to shareholders rose 318.6% to RMB 32.07 million. The company expanded production capacity significantly, increasing annual ultra-high-voltage insulator output from 1 million to 4 million pieces, supporting strong growth momentum.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jinlihua emphasizes its technological leadership in glass insulator manufacturing, including patented designs and advanced automated production lines that improve product quality and reduce costs. Its products feature superior electrical performance, durability, and reliability critical for stable power grid operation. The cultural segment differentiates through high artistic standards, original productions, and international collaborations, creating culturally impactful and commercially successful theatrical works.
